notes: The canonical target and all three dependency sets are retained exactly; the selected original resource has no package dependencies.
Source builds require the explicitly declared host C/C++ compiler, CMake, Ninja, CTest and Python commands. Their actual versions and executable identities are recorded.
Precompiled installation uses the actual OS/architecture, loader and runtime checks. Distribution names are provenance and are not an installation gate.
No ambient LD_ variables, host package transactions, source trimming or cross-prefix hard links are used.
Only installed pkg-config prefix metadata is made relative. Every such edit records before/after hashes; original source remains unchanged.
The complete original material qualification remains separate from this bounded native functional profile.

The original recipe/prepare.py and recipe/material-manifest.json are retained as historical material-profile files. The native profile executes only its declared build.py and check.py commands; no current native preparation qualification is inferred for that old material entry.
